concept.title: The Photos buttons
concept.shortdesc: What the buttons under Photos are for on a person, an event or a source.

conbody.p: A person's page, an event and a source each have a part named . It has three round-cornered buttons in a row. Under them, the page says No attachments yet until you add a picture.
The same three buttons appear when you attach a copy of a source. says which file to send to family, and whether the pictures go with it.

section.title: The camera button
section.p: The first button has a camera on it. It is for a new photo, such as a photo of a certificate.
The first time, the iPad asks if may use the camera. Choose to take photos in the app. If you do not allow it, a box says that the camera is needed to photograph a document.

section.title: The folder button
section.p: The second button has a folder on it. It is for a picture or a scan that is already on your iPad. The iPad's own Files screen opens. Choose a picture, or choose the cross at the top to leave it.

section.title: The chain button
section.p: The third button has a chain link on it. It is for a picture that is already in this tree, so you can use it again on a second person. A list named opens, with a box to search the pictures by what they show. A new tree has none yet. Choose to leave it.

section.title: The fourth button
section.p: When a page already has pictures, a fourth button shows, with an arrow that points down. It copies all the pictures of that page to a folder. The iPad's own screen for choosing a folder opens.
